Welcome to BrendaVsTwo🌟

Join me on the incredible journey of the life of a mom, creating content to share the ups and downs of parenting my adorable twin boys 👨‍👩‍👦‍👦

Our videos are edited with love and a touch of fun, making each moment unforgettable. 

Join our community of strong, kind-hearted individuals who respect and love their children. We've reached 94k subscribers, and our goal is to hit 100k! 🎯
Subscribe, like, and let's create unforgettable memories together! 🚀

#TwinMomLife #FamilyVlogs #VeterinaryPassion”

Upload schedule: I will be uploading twice a week, Tuesdays and Thursday at NOON Eastern time! Subscribe for more info!

Instagram: Brendavstwo
             

FOR COLLABORATION INQUIRIES: 
brendalozadac@gmail.com
